content.comment_body: Sorry if this has been asked before; I tried searching but couldn’t find an answer. How can the mathematical function be fully disabled once enabled? Setting the enable input to LOW doesn’t seem to work.
Just setting the enable input to LOW may not be enough. You also need to remove the checkmark for the last value in the function’s properties.
That works, thank you very much.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about disabling a mathematical function in a [company_name] product after activation. Their initial approach—setting the enable input to LOW—did not work. Another user explained that, in addition to changing the enable input, a specific property needs to be unchecked within the settings. This solution resolved the user’s issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the mathematical function to be disabled either by setting a low signal on the enable input or by using an easy-to-understand option in the interface.
